newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil eases, offers healthy.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil eases, offers healthy.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil fell again on Friday and offers were still healthy, traders said.
High sulphur barges traded at $90 fob ARA, a couple of dollars down from Thursday.

High sulphur cargo offers were softer too. Utilities reported two offers in the market: both in the hands of ARA players. One of these was heard to be loading this weekend, and the offer number was pegged at around $95/$96 cif NWE. But bids were heard to be at least a few dollars below this level.
A fresh vessel which traders expected would carry fuel oil, the 80,000 tonnes Omikronventure, was fixed to load in the U.S. Gulf next week to sail for Europe.
Low sulphur cargoes were assessed slightly weaker alongside crude oil, and talk of small pockets of demand in the Med appear not to have provided much in the way of support.
Prompt high sulphur Russian cargoes remain well supplied.
